parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Which page: a global page kind, or default_site for the page of the default site

200.description: The page as HTML (text/html), with sample values filled in

404.description: The place shows no page of its own, or the id does not exist

description:
Returns a global page as it is saved now, as HTML with sample values: the custom page when one is chosen, else the built-in one. default_site is the page the default site shows. The answer is 404 when the default site is a redirect or 444.

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)
